arg.name: mode
arg.description: The mode in which to start the lenient_multiplier node

arg.name: start_number_generator
arg.description: Whether to start the number_generator node

arg.name: frequency
arg.description: The frequency of the Number Generator. (Only available when 'start_number_generator' == True)

arg.name: initial_number
arg.description: The initial number of the Number Generator. (Only available when 'start_number_generator' == True)

arg.name: number_increment
arg.description: The amount the number increases each iteration of the Number Generator. (Only available when 'start_number_generator' == True)

log.message: Starting the Number Generator from $(var initial_number) @ $(var frequency) Hz
The lenient_multiplier node has been started, publish a number to multiply on /number
